meta_title: Bill Tracker — Envelope budgeting for your whole household
meta_desc: Simple envelope budgeting for couples and families. Plan money together, log expenses in seconds and see what's left. No bank login. Free on the App Store.
og_title: Bill Tracker — Budget together, envelope by envelope
hero_tagline: The simple envelope budgeting app for your whole household. Plan your money together, log expenses in seconds and always know what's left — no bank login, no sign-up.
hero_note: Free for iPhone and iPad · Premium with a 3-day free trial
hero_img_alt: Bill Tracker overview: how much is spent and left this month, and every envelope's budget
features_h2: One budget, everyone on the same page
features_lead: Give every part of your money a home. Bill Tracker brings classic envelope budgeting to the whole household — without ever asking for your bank login.
f1_p: Groceries, rent, eating out, kids — give each envelope a budget, or none at all, and see at a glance what's left and what's over. Your month can start on payday.
f2_p: Invite your partner, family or trip crew with a link. Everyone logs, everyone sees the same numbers — and kids or grandparents without a phone can be added by name.
f3_p: Income vs. expenses, top spending and changes since last month, for any period. See who spent what and filter by envelope or by person.
f4_p: Rent, salary and subscriptions appear automatically every month. Set any expense to repeat — even one you've already logged.
f5_p: Home, holiday, renovation — each space has its own members, envelopes, budget and currency. Switch between them in one tap.
f6_p: Amount, envelope, done — on a numpad made for thumbs. Works offline, on the bus or at the market.
f6_h_v11: Log it — or just ask Siri
f6_p_v11: Amount, envelope, done — on a numpad made for thumbs. Or say “Log expense in Bill Tracker” and tell Siri the amount, without opening the app.
f7_p: Euro, forint, krone, hryvnia or dollar — every currency in its proper local format, with a separate currency for each space.
f7_p_v11: Paid in dollars on holiday? Log it in the currency you actually paid. It's kept exactly as entered and listed separately, so your budget stays clean.
f8_p: No bank connection, no ads, no account to create, no selling your data. Shared spaces are stored in the EU. Your finances stay yours.
f9_p: English, Ukrainian, Hungarian, Norwegian, German, French, Portuguese and Spanish. Light and dark mode, and CSV export of all your data.
screens_lead: Everything important on one screen, and nothing you have to learn.
screen1: Overview — spent, left and every envelope
screen2: Log an expense in a few taps
how_lead: Up and running in under a minute. No account needed.
s1_p: Pick from ready-made categories or make your own. Set budgets now, later, or never.
s2_p: Amount, envelope, save. Recurring bills and salary take care of themselves.
s3_p: Share a link with your partner or family. Everyone's expenses appear on everyone's phone.
pricing_h2: Free to start. Premium when you grow.
pricing_lead: Everything you need to budget is free. Premium lifts the limits for bigger households.
free_4: Insights, recurring bills and CSV export
free_5: Joining someone's space by invite is always free
prem_sub: Monthly or yearly, with a 3-day free trial
prem_sub_v11: Monthly, yearly with a 3-day free trial, or once for life
prem_5: Lifetime option — pay once, no subscription
pricing_fine: Prices are shown in your local currency in the App Store. Subscriptions renew automatically until cancelled.
q1: Do I need to connect my bank?
a1: No, never. You log what you spend yourself, so Bill Tracker works with every bank in every country — and never sees your accounts.
q2: Do I need to create an account?
a2: No. Open the app and start budgeting. When you share a space, the app connects your devices in the background — no email, no password.
q3: Does everyone in my household need Premium?
a3: No. Accepting an invite link to join someone's space is always free.
q4: Which devices does it run on?
a4: iPhone and iPad with iOS 15 or later.
a5: Your budget stays on your device. Only spaces you share are synced, on servers in the EU, and only their members can see them. You can export everything to CSV or delete all your data in one step.
cta_lead: Your first budget is three taps away.
